seo.title: Gazi Md Emon — Video Editor & Motion Designer
seo.description: Gazi Md Emon — video editor for YouTube, ads and short-form. Watch the showreel, browse the 3D gallery and get a quote within 24 hours.

bio: I'm Emon — a video editor from Bangladesh. I started with gaming montages and YouTube cuts, and today I edit long-form videos, ads and short-form packs for creators and brands.
My obsession is retention: every cut, sound cue and caption exists to keep the viewer past the next second. Structure first, polish second — never the other way around.

services.title: YouTube long-form
services.description: Retention-first edits for docs, vlogs and video essays. Structure, pacing, sound design, motion captions.

services.title: Short-form packs
services.description: Vertical hooks built for the first 1.5 seconds. Packs of 4–12 cut from your long-form or raw footage.

services.title: Ads & brand films
services.description: 15–60s spots: grade, sound design, licensed music handling, motion graphics, all aspect ratios.

services.title: Motion graphics
services.description: Title packages, lower thirds, logo stings and explainer animation in After Effects.

process.title: Brief & quote
process.text: Send footage and a rough idea. You get a plan and a fixed quote within 24 hours.

process.title: First cut
process.text: Structure, pacing and sound are already locked in v1 — no placeholder edits.

process.title: Two revision rounds
process.text: Timestamped comments, fully async. No calls needed unless you want them.

process.title: Delivery
process.text: Final exports in every ratio and spec you need. Project files available on request.
